    // (tan x)' = x' / cos^2 x. Precondition: IValue is not an odd multiple of
    // a quarter turn, where the tangent and this rule both diverge.
    Tan(x: DualNumber): DualNumber
        => (x.Value.Tan, x.Derivative / x.Value.Cos.Square);
